items.title: Musk: It Takes “20 to 30 Million Robots” to Match America’s Output. That’s Optimus’ Market
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk says about 20 to 30 million humanoid robots would match US output of goods and services, and Tesla’s Optimus is chasing that market. Tesla still has to win a share of that market and earn a margin on it, and analysts don’t expect its normalized EPS to get far past fiscal 2023’s level until fiscal 2028.
